items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now you've got Preston Love and George Dorsey on altos. ... [INTERVIEWER] Preston Love, George Dorsey, Buddy Tate, and --

ctx.x: How was Preston Love as the first alto?
Well, Preston was -- his idol was Earl Warren.
Yeah. He told you that, didn't he Stan?
